video_title: BAHA BOYZ TAKE OVER TIMES SQUARE 👀🗽 LIDS NYC Shopping Spree Before NBA Finals Game 4

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Dallas Mavericks' struggle to contain the Boston Celtics' depth
quotes.excerpt: The Mavericks just don't have the answers for the depth Boston is throwing at them.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: The Mavericks just don't have the answers for the depth Boston is throwing at them. Every time they try to key in on one guy, someone else steps up.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: That is the luxury of having five guys who can all create their own shot. Dallas is playing hard, but they are playing uphill every single possession.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic needing more consistent help from his supporting cast
quotes.excerpt: Luka Doncic cannot win a championship by himself against a team this balanced.
quotes.quote: Luka Doncic cannot win a championship by himself against a team this balanced. He is putting up historic numbers, but when the pressure mounts in the fourth quarter, he needs someone else to step up and hit those high-leverage shots. It is too much weight for one player to carry for an entire series.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum's evolution as a playmaker during the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: Jayson Tatum has really matured in how he reads the defense and finds his teammates.
quotes.quote: Jayson Tatum has really matured in how he reads the defense and finds his teammates. Even when his own shot is not falling, he is not forcing the issue anymore. He is trusting the system and letting the game come to him, which is exactly what you need from a franchise superstar in the Finals.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The pressure on Luka Doncic to perform in NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: Luka Doncic has to be better. He has to be the best player on the floor.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Luka Doncic has to be better. He has to be the best player on the floor if they want to extend this series.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: It is not just about scoring. He has to control the pace and get his teammates involved early.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving's need to find his rhythm in Dallas
quotes.excerpt: Kyrie Irving needs to find his rhythm early. He cannot wait until the fourth quarter.
quotes.quote: Kyrie Irving needs to find his rhythm early. He cannot wait until the fourth quarter to start attacking. When he is aggressive, it opens up everything for the rest of the Mavericks offense.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: The defensive impact of Jayson Tatum in the Finals
quotes.excerpt: Jayson Tatum is doing everything on the defensive end, not just scoring.
quotes.quote: Jayson Tatum is doing everything on the defensive end, not just scoring. People focus on his shooting percentages, but his ability to switch and guard multiple positions is what makes Boston so dangerous.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's defensive struggles in the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: They are hunting Luka every single time down the floor.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: They are hunting Luka every single time down the floor. It is a mismatch every possession.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: That is the game plan. You have to make him work on that end if you want to win.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: The pressure on the Dallas Mavericks to avoid a sweep
quotes.excerpt: You cannot get swept on this stage. It is about pride now.
quotes.quote: You cannot get swept on this stage. It is about pride now. These guys have to show they belong here and at least steal one game to prove the series wasn't a total mismatch.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving's need to perform in Boston
quotes.excerpt: Kyrie has to be the guy. He knows the environment, he knows the crowd.
quotes.quote: Kyrie has to be the guy. He knows the environment, he knows the crowd. If he doesn't come out aggressive and set the tone early, Dallas is going to be in a world of trouble.
